3. **Application bug**: The application running inside the container has a bug, causing it to crash and restart repeatedly. Confidence: 0.6 (the container's exit code is 1, which may indicate an application-level error, but logs are unavailable, as shown in kubectl logs -n triagent-demo crashloop-001-0-6bdb85bdff-hsstb -c app --previous).
